title: review: stop reference-less agent findings in privacy and UI/accessibility leaves
summary: Privacy and UI/accessibility code review skills now emit only knowledge-backed findings instead of general agent-generated findings, reducing false positives while maintaining accuracy.
key_points: Restricts al-privacy-review and al-ui-review to reference-backed findings only
Removes agent-finding channel that generated 86% of false positives in these domains
Eliminates 19 false positives at cost of at most 1 true positive
Higher-yield domains keep their agent channel for now
Instruction-only change with no detection logic modification
